text:
jordan: Quick ping — I opened a tiny PR that runs a lint pass over the messageflow/streaming contract. Trying to catch ambiguous fields before the convo rollout. link: https://gh.redwood.ai/r/redwood/inference/pulls/2149

nina: thanks — saw the diff. main thing i noticed is the `event_type` vs `type` rename in streaming deltas. is that intentional for the sdk?

jordan: yep intentional. `event_type` avoids collision with user payload `type` fields. SDK change is staggered — i added a compact shim in the PR:```
// server -> client
{"event_type":"delta","payload":{...}}
// shim keeps `type` for old clients
```

alex: ok can we add a short compatibility note in the schema file? one-liner that old clients get `type` fallback for 30 days, then removed.

jordan: added note in the PR description and added the fallback header to the request inspector. also added a small test that verifies both shapes are accepted.

sam: nit: in the tool_call object, args are sometimes strings and sometimes objects in examples. can we make examples consistent? it confuses SDK mobility.

jordan: good catch. i normalized examples to objects across the board. left a comment in the PR for reviewers to scan `examples/*` only.

nina: quick compatibility question — function calling: are we preserving `tool_name` casing? current runtime lowercases names which broke a few downstream router keys last week.

jordan: runtime will preserve the declared `tool_name` in the contract. the lowercase-only behavior was a bug in the router shim and i've filed issue #1032 to fix the router. PR references it.

alex: i skimmed tests — streaming endflag now emits `event_type: end` with optional `reason`. good. small ask: include example of `reason: "fallback"` so ops can parse metrics.

jordan: added `reason` example. also added metrics tag `stream_end:reason=fallback` in the event docs.

pr-bot: CI passed for jordan/messageflow-contract-lint (2149) :white_check_mark:

sam: LGTM from infra side. can someone from sdk-team confirm the shim shape is straightforward? @nina?

nina: will review in the morning — should be small. if no blockers i'll approve and we can canary the rollout to staging later today. :rocket:

jordan: thanks all. if anyone finds edge cases ping here. i plan to merge after sdk ack or by EOD if no responses. :+1:
